rationale: The planner correctly recognized that the data state (raw paired-end FASTQs, no count matrix, no quantifier, no transcriptome reference) precludes any differential expression test and stopped with a precise, actionable question naming the quantification options (Salmon/kallisto, STAR/HISAT2, Rsubread) and the reference/annotation version in play, which matches the reference's correct outcome. It did not fabricate a count file or run DESeq2 on nothing, and enrichment was rightly omitted. However, no downstream plan was stated at all: nothing on sample QC, filtering, in-model normalization, the ~condition design with the control reference level, BH at 0.05 with LFC shrinkage, the low-power caveat of three-versus-three, or report contents, so those criteria score near zero because the plan says nothing about them.
